name: check_spare_parts
description: Check spare part availability: stock levels by warehouse location with bin numbers, reorder status, EOQ, lead time, criticality, alternative parts, and usage rate.

part_number.description: Part number identifier (e.g., 'BRG-6205', 'SEL-3500', 'FLT-0047'). Prefix determines category: BRG, SEL, FLT, BLT, LUB, VLV

name: order_spare_parts
description: Create a spare parts purchase order. Returns order confirmation, cost breakdown (subtotal, shipping, tax), supplier, estimated delivery, and approval status (orders under $1,000 auto-approve).

quantity.description: Number of units to order (positive integer)

name: get_parts_forecast
description: Forecast spare parts needed for an equipment over the next 90 days by cross-referencing failure predictions, maintenance schedules, and consumption. Returns parts with need-by dates, stock sufficiency, and procurement summary.

name: get_parts_inventory_report
description: Get the overall spare parts inventory health report: value and stockouts by category, critical stockouts with affected equipment, KPIs (turnover, fill rate, dead stock, carrying cost), and recommendations.
